title: Playing Hopscotch
text:
Ania likes to play hopscotch with her friends. They draw boxes with chalk on the ground. Each child throws a stone into a box and jumps on one leg. The game is fun and easy to learn.

On Saturday, Ania and her friends play in the park. Her brother, Kuba, plays too. They laugh a lot and count the jumps together. At the end of the day, they are tired but very happy.

questions.text: What do the children draw on the ground?
Where do Ania and her friends play on Saturday?
Why are the children tired at the end of the day?
options: They played for a long time

questions.text: How does Ania probably feel about hopscotch?
options: She does not want to play
She is afraid of the game
She is trying to win money

vocabulary.definition: an activity that people play for fun
shapes with four straight sides drawn or made
movements where you push off the ground and move into the air

paragraph_translations: Ania lubi grać w klasy z przyjaciółmi. Rysują kredą pola na ziemi. Każde dziecko rzuca kamyk do pola i skacze na jednej nodze. Gra jest zabawna i łatwa do nauczenia.
W sobotę Ania i jej przyjaciele bawią się w parku. Gra z nimi jej brat, Kuba. Dużo się śmieją i razem liczą skoki. Pod koniec dnia są zmęczeni, ale bardzo szczęśliwi.
